paper_title: The Role of Model Architecture and Scale in Predicting Molecular   Properties Insights from Fine-Tuning RoBERTa, BART, and LLaMA
caption: Training Loss vs. Steps for Each Model Type by Model Size with a Data Size of 20 millions. The loss trends for 10 million and 20 million datasets are similar.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the training loss over the number of steps for various model architectures and sizes. The x-axis represents the number of steps, ranging from approximately 20,000 to 440,000, with tick labels spaced approximately 40,000 units apart. The y-axis displays the training loss, measured on a logarithmic scale with values ranging from 0 to 0.85, and marked with increments of 0.05. The ChemBART Small 20M line is represented by a solid red line, beginning at approximately 0.83 and decreasing to a value of around 0.23 by the end of the x-axis.  The ChemBERT Small 20M line is depicted as a solid orange line, starting at approximately 0.85 and reaching a value of approximately 0.35. The ChemBERTa Small 20M line is shown as a solid green line, beginning at approximately 0.85 and decreasing to a value of approximately 0.33. The ChemLLaMA Small 20M line is represented by a solid purple line, starting at approximately 0.85 and decreasing to a value of approximately 0.26. The ChemLLaMA Medium line is displayed as a solid magenta line, starting at approximately 0.85 and decreasing to a value of approximately 0.31.
